top_categories.workout_context: At mile 60 of 106, glycogen is gone. This workout teaches your body to produce watts on fumes.
61ft/mi means long efforts at or near FTP on every climb. If your threshold cracks at minute 15, you'll walk the rest.
Race-pace efforts that mimic Eroica South Africa's demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before April.
Eroica South Africa's mixed terrain forces constant power changes. Accelerate over rises and out of corners, settle on the open road, and repeat for 106 miles.
At Eroica South Africa, surges push you above threshold and you have to recover while still riding. Over-unders train exactly that.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of Eroica South Africa. Train it until it feels boring.
Every hard session works better with a bigger aerobic base. At 106 miles, base fitness is the difference between racing and surviving.
106 miles rewards fat oxidation. This volume work shifts your fuel mix so you're still burning fat at hour 5, not bonking at hour 3.
6,489ft of climbing on grades that change every minute. You need to switch from seated to standing without losing rhythm.
6,489ft of climbing means repeated surges above threshold. VO2max work is how you survive the fifth climb, not just the first.
Endurance with intensity spikes baked in. Exactly what 6,489ft of climbing on mixed terrain does to your power file on race day.
Two threshold sessions per week without the recovery cost of VO2max work. For 106 miles, sustainable FTP gains matter more than peak power.

race_overlay.heat: April in Montagu, Western Cape, South Africa can bring heat. If the forecast warrants it, include controlled heat exposure before Eroica South Africa and rehearse the drinking and electrolyte plan you tolerate in training. Do not introduce a fixed sodium protocol solely from this preview.
race_overlay.nutrition: Target 60–80g carbs/hour for Eroica South Africa’s 106 miles. Start fueling within the first 30 minutes — early fueling prevents late-race collapse. Bonking at mile 60 is a nutrition failure, not a fitness failure.
race_overlay.terrain: Mixed terrain at Eroica South Africa requires surface adaptability. Include weekly rides on mixed terrain to build confidence.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on Durability, TT Threshold, and Race Simulation to prepare you for 106 miles of mixed terrain in Montagu, Western Cape, South Africa.
